units.source_text: 薰中纳言自己于二女公子乔迁前一日清早来到宇治，照例被招待在那客室里坐憩。

en.t: Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, came to Uji early in the morning on the day before the Second Princess was to move, and as usual he was received and rested in that guest room.

units.source_text: 他独自思量：

en.t: He thought to himself:

units.source_text: “如果大女公子在世，现在我已和她相亲相爱，我将趁先迎接她进京去了。”

en.t: If the Elder Princess were still alive, by now she and I would have loved each other, and I would have taken this chance to bring her to the capital first.

units.source_text: 便历历回忆大女公子容貌、言语和性情。

en.t: He then vividly recalled the Elder Princess's appearance, words, and disposition.

units.source_text: 又想：

en.t: He thought again:

units.source_text: “她虽然不曾容允我，毕竟并不厌恶我，从来不曾严词厉色地拒绝我。

en.t: Although she never accepted me, after all she did not hate me, and she never once rejected me with harsh words or a severe manner.

units.source_text: 正因我自己脾气古怪，以致造成障碍。”

en.t: It was precisely because my own temperament was strange that obstacles arose.

units.source_text: 他辗转寻思，不胜悲痛。

en.t: He turned these thoughts over and over, unable to bear his grief.

units.source_text: 忽然想起这里的纸隔扇上有一个洞，

en.t: Suddenly he remembered that there was a hole in the paper sliding screen here,

units.source_text: 他从前曾经从这里偷窥，

en.t: and that he had once peered through it before,

units.source_text: 便走近去看。

en.t: so he walked over to look.

units.source_text: 但见里面帘子挂下，一点也看不见。

en.t: But inside the blinds had been lowered, and he could not see anything at all.

units.source_text: 室内众侍女怀念大女公子，都在吞声饮泣。

en.t: Inside, all the waiting women were thinking of the Elder Princess and were stifling their sobs.

units.source_text: 二女公子更是泪如泉涌，无心计虑明日迁居之事，

en.t: The Second Princess was weeping even more profusely and had no heart to think about the move on the next day,

units.source_text: 只是茫然若失地躺着。

en.t: but only lay there in a daze, as if bereft of everything.

units.source_text: 薰中纳言叫侍女向她传言：

en.t: Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, had a waiting woman convey this message to her:

units.source_text: “连月不曾奉访，其间忧愁苦恨，难以言传。

en.t: For months I have been unable to visit you, and the sorrow and suffering I have felt in that time are beyond words.

units.source_text: 今日拟向小姐略陈一二，俾得稍慰寸心。

en.t: Today I hope to say a little of it to you, my lady, so that I may somewhat comfort my heart.

units.source_text: 务望照例接见，请勿见拒为幸。

en.t: I earnestly hope you will receive me as before, and I would be grateful if you do not refuse me.

units.source_text: 不然，我犹似流落异国，越发痛苦了。”

en.t: Otherwise I will feel as though I have been cast adrift in a foreign land, and my pain will grow still greater.

units.source_text: 二女公子颇感为难，说道：

en.t: The Second Princess felt deeply troubled and said:

units.source_text: “我并不想使他伤心。

en.t: I do not wish to make him sad.

units.source_text: 不过哎呀！

en.t: But, oh!

units.source_text: 我的心情如此恶劣，深恐言语错乱，应对失礼，实甚担心。”

en.t: My spirits are in such a terrible state that I am deeply afraid my words will become confused and my replies will be discourteous.

units.source_text: 众侍女你一言我一语地说：

en.t: The waiting women all spoke up, one after another:

units.source_text: “对人不起的！”

en.t: That would be unfair to him!

units.source_text: 于是在里间的纸隔扇旁边和他晤谈。

en.t: And so she spoke with him beside the paper sliding screen in the inner room.
